section_header: EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEMS — Three-Way Catalyst (TWC) System
title: INSPECTION OF HEAT INSULATOR and REPLACEMENT OF CATALYTIC CONVERTER

content.description: Side view diagram showing heat insulator positioned above catalytic converter in exhaust system

items: CHECK FOR ADEQUATE CLEARANCE BETWEEN CATALYTIC CONVERTER AND HEAT INSULATOR

content.description: Illustration showing catalytic converter with mounting bolts and connection points to exhaust pipes

items: Check that the converter is cool.
Remove the bolts at the front and rear of the converter.
Place new gaskets on the converter front and rear pipes, and connect the converter to the exhaust pipes.
Reinstall the bracket bolts and tighten them.
